instructions.ref: JC 2023 55, draft RTS Article 1, point (5), inserting Article 6(4) (report p. 26)
instructions.quote: Where the result of the netting is below zero, financial market participants shall not include this result in the “impact” column

instructions.ref: JC 2023 55, draft RTS Article 1, point (5), inserting Article 6(6) (report p. 26)
instructions.quote: Financial market participants shall disclose in the column ‘Explanation’ in the section ‘Description of the principal adverse impacts on sustainability factors’ in Table 1 of Annex I, the proportion of their calculation that is based on information obtained

instructions.ref: JC 2023 55, draft RTS Annex I, formula (1) (report p. 66) (formula typeset as math glyphs in the PDF; not machine-checkable; visual/extracted transcription: for x in {1,2,3}, Total: sum_{i=1..n} (current value of investment_i / investee company's enterprise value_i x investee company's Scope(x) GHG emissions_i (tCO2eq)), where n is the number of investee companies in the investments)
instructions.quote: ‘GHG emissions’ shall be calculated in accordance with the following formula:

instructions.ref: JC 2023 55, draft RTS Annex I, formula (2) (report p. 66) (formula typeset as math glyphs in the PDF; not machine-checkable; visual/extracted transcription: [sum_{i=1..n} (current value of investment_i / investee company's enterprise value_i x investee company's Scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG emissions_i (tCO2eq))] / current value of all investments (EUR M))
instructions.quote: ‘carbon footprint’ shall be calculated in accordance with the following formula:

instructions.ref: JC 2023 55, draft RTS Annex I, formula (3) (report p. 66) (formula typeset as math glyphs in the PDF; not machine-checkable; visual/extracted transcription: sum_{i=1..n} (current value of investment_i / current value of all investments x investee company's Scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG emissions_i (tCO2eq) / investee company's EUR M revenue_i))
instructions.quote: ‘GHG intensity of investee companies’ shall be calculated in accordance with the following formula:

instructions.ref: JC 2023 55, draft RTS Annex I, definition (1) (report p. 59)
instructions.quote: ‘current value of investment’ means the value in EUR of the investment by the financial market participant in the investee company;

instructions.ref: JC 2023 55, draft RTS Annex I, definition (2) (report p. 59)
instructions.quote: ‘enterprise value’ means the sum, at fiscal year-end, of the market capitalisation of ordinary shares, the market capitalisation of preferred shares, and the book value of total debt and non-controlling interests, without the deduction of cash or cash equivalents;

instructions.ref: JC 2023 55, draft RTS Annex I, definition (4) (report p. 59), followed by points i.-iv. per type of financial market participant
instructions.quote: ‘current value of all investments’ means the value in EUR of the following investments of the financial market participant:
